reason: A DSH plugin that periodically checks the npm registry for newer versions, displays persistent update status in the sidebar, and offers user-confirmed update, ignore, and snooze actions.

summaries.zh: 在侧边栏显示 DSH 当前版本并定期检查 npm 是否有更新，提供更新提示、忽略、稍后处理及经确认后执行更新的功能。
summaries.en: Displays the installed DSH version in the sidebar, checks npm periodically for updates, and provides update notifications, snoozing, ignoring, and user-confirmed update actions.

capabilities: Reads the installed DSH version from the local installation
Queries npm registry metadata over HTTPS
Stores an ignored-version value in browser localStorage
After explicit confirmation, executes npm update commands under the user account and may terminate the current process
